attrs.evidence: spec_vectors.mjs v0.2.0: VERIFY mode builds a candidate corpus in memory, compares it byte for byte with the frozen corpus at docs/spec/proof-wire/vectors/, names which expectation moved, and digests the specification tree before and after to prove it wrote nothing; UPDATE mode requires --spec-revision and is run by a human. spec_agreement.mjs compares the normative schema at docs/spec/proof-wire/schema/ with the checker's own exported declarations -- 10 record grammars, 46 fields and planes, 30 refusal codes (TRVM-P0.1 split the overloaded nest-policy-weakened), 7 id prefixes MEASURED BY MINTING ONE ID OF EACH KIND rather than by reading a table beside the schema's, scope, reference contract, child-protocol table, both domain-separation strings and 6 policy values -- and asserts on the SOURCE of all five runtime files that none of them references the schema. Gate `gov-nest`; grid booleans conformance-oracle-frozen and spec-grammar-agrees, each falsified independently.
attrs.statement: AN IMPLEMENTATION UNDER CONFORMANCE TEST MAY NOT GENERATE, REWRITE OR REDEFINE THE EXPECTED VALUES AGAINST WHICH THAT SAME IMPLEMENTATION IS JUDGED. A generator that imports the live implementation and writes its results into the normative vector tree, run by the verification script, computes both the answer and the answer key: measured, changing one implementation-only constant -- the artifact-root domain separator, from TRVM-ARTIFACT-ROOT-v2 to -v999 -- while touching no specification moved every expected root and the conformance gate reported PASS. The corpus MUST be committed, MUST carry a spec revision, and MUST be READ by a verification run; regenerating it is a normative act that names the revision it produces and that no gate performs. A verification run MUST leave the specification tree byte-identical, and that MUST be measured rather than promised. AND AN EXPECTATION IS COMPARED FOR EXACT EQUALITY, NOT CONTAINMENT: a declared refusal SET checked as a subset of the measured one lets a checker acquire additional refusal semantics silently -- a single-fault vector given a second fault still passed. Sets are sorted before they are frozen, so byte equality IS set equality and refusal ORDER remains outside the protocol. THE SAME CIRCULARITY EXISTS ONE LEVEL UP: an audit whose denominator is the checker's OWN grammar cannot see a field deleted from the checker, from the check that enforced it and from the producer -- measured, the audit reports 45/45 PASS while the protocol has 46 fields. A normative machine-readable grammar is required, and THE RUNTIME MUST NOT IMPORT IT, because two declarations that read one object agree by construction.
